row.name: Import from Kettu
row.description: Bring the sessions, memory and artifacts of the official Kettu app on this computer here, with their titles, projects, pins and archives. Kettu's data is only read.
row.keywords: kettu import migrate move sessions projects memory artifacts
row.notFound: No Kettu data on this computer.

error.newer: Kettu's data is from a newer version than this app reads. Update this app and try again.
error.unreadable: Kettu's sessions could not be read.
error.scan: Could not look for Kettu's data: {{error}}

dialog.title: Import from Kettu
dialog.description: Found {{found}} in Kettu. The chosen sessions come over with their titles, projects, pins and archives, and pick up where they left off.
dialog.readOnly: Kettu's data is only read: its sessions, memory and artifacts stay there as they are. A session Kettu has open right now comes over as a copy; quit Kettu first to continue the same one. Subagents come back under their session when it is opened here.
dialog.noSessions: Kettu has no sessions to import.

extras.title: Also import
extras.memoryHint: Global memory, about you, comes over as global memory; project memory into the same project. Copies are skipped, and the undo history stays.
extras.artifactsHint: Each comes with its title and every version; copies are skipped. Kettu's sharing links belong to its account and do not come over, nor does its Recently deleted.
